notebooks.title: 正交系数与幅相
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
x = sp.cos(2*sp.pi*t)+sp.cos(6*sp.pi*t)/2
for k in [0,1,2,3]:
    a = sp.integrate(2*x*sp.cos(2*sp.pi*k*t),(t,0,1))
    b = sp.integrate(2*x*sp.sin(2*sp.pi*k*t),(t,0,1))
    print('n/a/b:',k,a,b)
for k in [-3,-1,0,1,3]:
    c = sp.integrate(sp.expand_trig(x)*sp.expand_complex(sp.exp(-2*sp.pi*sp.I*k*t)),(t,0,1))
    print('n/c:',k,sp.simplify(c))
phase_signal = sp.cos(2*sp.pi*t)-sp.sin(6*sp.pi*t)/2
print('相位90度的a3/b3/c3/起点:',0,-sp.Rational(1,2),sp.I/4,phase_signal.subs(t,0))
ms = sp.integrate(x*x,(t,0,1))
phase_ms = sp.integrate(phase_signal**2,(t,0,1))
print('均值/均方/改相位均方/RMS:',sp.integrate(x,(t,0,1)),ms,phase_ms,sp.sqrt(ms),sp.N(sp.sqrt(ms),12))

notebooks.title: 方波系数与有限截断
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
import numpy as np
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
for n in [1,2,3,5]:
    b = 2*(sp.integrate(sp.sin(2*sp.pi*n*t),(t,0,sp.Rational(1,2)))-sp.integrate(sp.sin(2*sp.pi*n*t),(t,sp.Rational(1,2),1)))
    print('方波n/b:',n,sp.simplify(b))
for N in [1,3,15]:
    quarter = sp.simplify(sum(4*sp.sin(sp.pi*(2*k-1)/2)/(sp.pi*(2*k-1)) for k in range(1,N+1)))
    ms = sp.simplify(sum(8/(sp.pi**2*(2*k-1)**2) for k in range(1,N+1)))
    grid = np.linspace(0,1,20001)
    values = sum(4*np.sin(2*np.pi*(2*k-1)*grid)/(np.pi*(2*k-1)) for k in range(1,N+1))
    print('N/四分之一时刻/均方:',N,quarter,sp.N(quarter,12),sp.N(ms,12))
    print('网格采样最大值（非连续精确峰）:',float(values.max()))
print('跳点有限和:',0)

notebooks.title: 普通傅里叶变换与单位约定
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t,w = sp.symbols('t w', real=True)

cells.code:
# 对任意实w，复权重模为1，绝对积分界为2，故下列无条件化简有明确依据
absolute_bound = sp.integrate(sp.exp(t),(t,-sp.oo,0))+sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t),(t,0,sp.oo))
print('任意实频率的绝对积分界:',absolute_bound)
X = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(sp.exp(t)*sp.exp(-sp.I*w*t),(t,-sp.oo,0),conds='none')+sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t)*sp.exp(-sp.I*w*t),(t,0,sp.oo),conds='none'))
box = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(sp.exp(-sp.I*w*t),(t,-1,1)))
print('双边衰减变换/零频/一弧度:',X,X.subs(w,0),X.subs(w,1))
print('逆式在t0的积分:',sp.integrate(2/(1+w*w),(w,-sp.oo,sp.oo))/(2*sp.pi))
print('矩形脉冲变换:',box)
print('矩形零频/第一正零点:',sp.limit(2*sp.sin(w)/w,w,0),sp.simplify(2*sp.sin(sp.pi)/sp.pi))
print('延迟2秒的一弧度变换:',sp.exp(-2*sp.I)*X.subs(w,1))

notebooks.title: 延迟卷积与稳定频响
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t,r = sp.symbols('t r', positive=True)
w = sp.symbols('w', real=True)

cells.code:
# w为实数，e^-t及t*e^-t都绝对可积；导数绝对值亦被(1+t)e^-t控制
print('三种积分的绝对界:',1,1,sp.integrate((1+t)*sp.exp(-t),(t,0,sp.oo)))
H = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(sp.exp(-t)*sp.exp(-sp.I*w*t),(t,0,sp.oo),conds='none'))
continuous = sp.simplify(sp.integrate(t*sp.exp(-t)*sp.exp(-sp.I*w*t),(t,0,sp.oo),conds='none'))
derivative = sp.simplify(sp.integrate((1-t)*sp.exp(-t)*sp.exp(-sp.I*w*t),(t,0,sp.oo),conds='none'))
conv = sp.integrate(sp.exp(-r)*sp.exp(-(t-r)),(r,0,t))
print('核H/卷积函数/卷积变换:',H,conv,continuous)
print('导数规则余量:',sp.simplify(derivative-sp.I*w*continuous))
H1 = sp.simplify(H.subs(w,1))
print('一弧度H/增益/相位:',H1,sp.Abs(H1),sp.arg(H1))
print('一Hz增益:',sp.simplify(sp.Abs(H.subs(w,2*sp.pi))),sp.N(sp.Abs(H.subs(w,2*sp.pi)),12))

N = 64
fs = 64.0
n = np.arange(N)
x = np.cos(2*np.pi*n/fs)+.5*np.cos(6*np.pi*n/fs)
X = np.fft.fft(x)
print('正/负频率格及模:',[1,3,63,61],np.abs(X[[1,3,63,61]]))
print('单边幅值:',2*np.abs(X[[1,3]])/N)
print('均值/时域均方/DFT均方:',x.mean(),np.mean(x*x),np.sum(np.abs(X)**2)/N**2)
print('逆变换最大误差:',np.max(np.abs(np.fft.ifft(X).real-x)))
print('频率格间隔:',fs/N)

notebooks.title: 混叠泄漏与端点归一化

cells.code:
N=64
n=np.arange(N)
a=np.cos(2*np.pi*3*n/N)
b=np.cos(2*np.pi*61*n/N)
print('3Hz与61Hz采样最大差:',np.max(np.abs(a-b)))
print('奈奎斯特正弦采样最大绝对值:',np.max(np.abs(np.sin(np.pi*n))))
for f in [3,3.5]:
    X=np.fft.rfft(np.cos(2*np.pi*f*n/N))
    amplitudes=2*np.abs(X)/N
    amplitudes[0]/=2
    amplitudes[-1]/=2
    print('输入Hz/格3,4单边幅值:',f,amplitudes[[3,4]])
for label,x in [('DC2',np.full(N,2.0)),('Nyquist',np.cos(np.pi*n))]:
    X=np.fft.rfft(x)
    print('端点例/正确幅值:',label,np.abs(X[0])/N,np.abs(X[-1])/N)

notebooks.title: 六题答案复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
import numpy as np
t,w = sp.symbols('t w', real=True)

cells.code:
print('题1周期/Hz/角频率/双边系数:',1,[1,3],[2*sp.pi,6*sp.pi],[sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4)])
p=sp.cos(2*sp.pi*t)-sp.sin(6*sp.pi*t)/2
print('题2 a3/b3/c3/起点/均方:',0,-sp.Rational(1,2),sp.I/4,p.subs(t,0),sp.integrate(p*p,(t,0,1)))
print('题3:',4/sp.pi,52/(15*sp.pi),0)
X=2/(1+w*w)
print('题4:',X,X.subs(w,0),X.subs(w,1),sp.exp(-2*sp.I))
print('题5 H1/增益/相位/一Hz增益:',(1-sp.I)/2,sp.sqrt(2)/2,-sp.pi/4,1/sp.sqrt(1+4*sp.pi**2))
n=np.arange(64)
x=np.cos(2*np.pi*n/64)+.5*np.cos(6*np.pi*n/64)
D=np.fft.fft(x)
print('题6原始模/单边幅值:',np.abs(D[[1,3]]),2*np.abs(D[[1,3]])/64)
leak=np.fft.rfft(np.cos(2*np.pi*3.5*n/64))
print('题6泄漏格3/4:',2*np.abs(leak[[3,4]])/64)
print('题6端点幅值:',np.abs(np.fft.rfft(np.full(64,2.0))[0])/64,np.abs(np.fft.rfft(np.cos(np.pi*n))[-1])/64)
